scripts.setup: npm install && cd vscode-extension/webview && bun install && cd ../.. && cd agent-core && bun install && cd .. && cd mcp-bridge && bun install
scripts.build:all: npm run build:extension && npm run build:webview && npm run build:agent
scripts.lint:all: cd mcp-bridge && bun run lint && cd ../agent-core && bun run lint && cd ../vscode-extension && bun run lint
scripts.test:unit: bun run test:agent && bun run test:mcp && cd vscode-extension && bun run test:unit && cd .. && cd kb && pytest tests/unit/
scripts.test:integration: cd vscode-extension && bun run test:integration && cd ../kb && pytest tests/integration/
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test --workspace vscode-extension && npm run test --workspace vscode-extension/playwright
scripts.test:all: npm run test:agent && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:kb && npm run test:e2e
